annotations.text:
Audit log redesign. Kojo chose A (Ledger) on 2026-09-05.

Kept from live: platform shell (blue accent, 260px sidebar), 24px page title, severity families (red / amber / green / neutral), ring pills, rail dots, gray-200 cards at 16px radius.

Staff names, stores, IPs and counts are sample data. Real action names from PlatformAuditLog.

A. Ledger (chosen)

A register you can search. Family chips with counts, severity + date filters, sticky day bands, one row per event with actor, target and the first detail; the rest folds into a +N count and opens on click.

Live pill shows a count of new events and reloads on click.

B. Journal (not chosen)

Reads like a diary: 24h stat tiles, then sentences with the actor's avatar and the reason quoted. Side rail shows who was most active and which area moved.

Tradeoff: tall. Slower to scan when you are hunting one specific event.

C. Inspector (not chosen)

Split view, like Directory Studio on /platform/stores. Compact list left, full record right.

Tradeoff: one event at a time. Weakest overview of the three.
